checks.explanation: Nvidia's AI-driven data center business remained extremely strong through the roughly two-year window following August 2024, with continued explosive revenue and earnings growth into 2026.

Competitive alternatives (custom silicon from hyperscalers, AMD's MI-series) did emerge and grow within the predicted 1-2 year window, applying some pricing pressure, but Nvidia has maintained dominant market share and strong margins through mid-2026 rather than experiencing the predicted sustainability collapse.

RFK Jr. ultimately dropped out of the race and endorsed Trump in August 2024 rather than remaining a spoiler candidate through Election Day, making the original vote-splitting comparison largely moot, though the endorsement itself supports the view that his base leaned more toward Trump.

No such sweeping Medicare GLP-1 coverage bill covering roughly 74% of Americans at $1,500/week was passed; Medicare's GLP-1 drug coverage remained limited and far short of the described $3 trillion annual cost scenario as of 2026.

Trump's second term has indeed differed in some respects from his first (more aggressive use of executive power, DOGE, tariff policy), which many observers have noted, though this is a subjective characterization rather than a cleanly falsifiable claim.
Trump won the 2024 election, and Robert F. Kennedy Jr. was subsequently involved in the transition and went on to serve as US Secretary of Health and Human Services in the Trump administration.
Kamala Harris and Tim Walz did appear together in a joint CNN interview with Dana Bash, which aired on Thursday, August 29, 2024.
